mapper.update: UPDATE crm_ai_job j SET j.status='RUNNING',j.claimed_by=#{owner},j.claimed_until=#{until},j.attempt_count=j.attempt_count+1,j.updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),j.version=j.version+1 WHERE j.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND j.id=#{id} AND j.version=#{version} AND ((j.status IN ('QUEUED','RETRY')) OR (j.status='RUNNING' AND j.claimed_until<#{now}))

UPDATE crm_ai_job j SET j.status='PROPOSED',j.provider=#{provider},j.model_name=#{model},j.error_masked=NULL,j.claimed_by=NULL,j.claimed_until=NULL,j.updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),j.version=j.version+1 WHERE j.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND j.id=#{id} AND j.version=#{version} AND j.status='RUNNING'

UPDATE crm_ai_job j SET j.status=IF(#{terminal},'FAILED','RETRY'),j.error_masked=#{error},j.next_retry_at=#{nextRetryAt},j.claimed_by=NULL,j.claimed_until=NULL,j.updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),j.version=j.version+1 WHERE j.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND j.id=#{id} AND j.version=#{version} AND j.status='RUNNING'

UPDATE crm_ai_job j SET j.status=#{status},j.confirmed_by=#{actorUserId},j.confirmed_at=#{now},j.confirmation_reason=#{reason},j.confirmation_key=#{key},j.confirmation_hash=#{hash},j.task_id=#{taskId},j.updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),j.version=j.version+1 WHERE j.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND j.id=#{id} AND j.version=#{version} AND j.status='PROPOSED'
